findings.message: ClickEventRecorder + V2__click_analytics.sql create the row with idempotency_key/short_code/occurred_at/hashed_ip/referrer_host and RedirectClickRecordingIT/RedirectClickRecordingTest cover it, but the T3 note states the insert runs in "ClickEventRecorder's own @Transactional write transaction ... UrlReadService (not in allowed files) keeps its read-only lookup transaction". The AC requires the row to be committed in the same transaction as redirect handling; as implemented it is a separate transaction, so atomicity with redirect handling is not demonstrated by any test.

No-Kafka-on-request-path is evidenced by T3 note and RedirectClickRecordingTest, but the planned proof (T8 class <base>.analytics.it.KafkaUnavailableRedirectIT) is absent from files_changed/tests_added, so "redirect unchanged with broker down and event stays PENDING" is unverified.
T7 was not delivered: no commit for T7 and no src/main/java/com/example/shortener/analytics/api/** (ClickStatsController/ClickStatsResponse/ClickStatsQueryService) or tests in files_changed.
No stats endpoint exists (no analytics/api package, no MockMvc test for 404) in the changeset.
Planned RedirectLatencyBudgetIT (T8) and the CI gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml) are absent; no baseline or p95 comparison artifact in the changeset.
as_of semantics live in ClickStatsQueryService/ClickStatsResponse (T7), which are not present in files_changed; no test covers published-but-unconsumed eventual consistency.
